correctness.rationale: Both singleton letters must be hit and 10 occurs only at the central B/C boundary, so the outer-run pair is impossible. Longest unary factors force the stated length dominance in each remaining run pair. In A/B the 10 test forces the last B position and 01 forces the last A position unless b=1; reverse-complement gives C/D. For B/C the 10 and 01 tests give the two endpoint disjunctions. All 01-type factors whose exponents fit both boundaries are covered by the 01 disjunction. The two one-boundary-only regimes are decided by their shortest distinguishing factors, 01^(d+1) and 0^(a+1)1, which give t<=d+1 and z>=c-a. Every factor passing through the central transition contains both endpoints of that transition and is met. The middle-run count follows by taking b=1, c=1, or both greater than one; in the last case only offsets (1,1) and (b,c) can remain. When b>=d the last positions of A,B,C hit all three boundaries and include a longest run of each letter. Otherwise the last of A and the first positions of C,D do the same. Thus the minimum is three exactly when all three two-position families are empty, giving the two claimed regions including the strict and one-unit boundaries.
